ns2:section.sectionText: Please note the stated prerequisites. The registration system may allow you to select this course even if you do not meet the prerequisites; however, you will be removed from the course if you have not met them. You must simultaneously register for both the 'AL1' Lecture AND an 'A' Lab to complete registration for this course.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to students with Sophomore, Junior, or Senior class standing.
